title: The MacBook Pro's OLED PWM Problem: When a 'Better' Display Becomes Worse to Use
llm_summary: Apple’s newest MacBook Pro models use an OLED panel that, while delivering richer colors and deeper blacks, relies on pulse‑width modulation (PWM) to dim the screen.
